summary: Pristine copies of vibeline at an exact upstream pin, vendored under Orbit contrib/vibeline/ as inert reference material with a SHA-256 manifest.

upstream.name: vibeline
upstream.pin_source: refs/heads/main pointed at this exact commit at fetch time (verified via git ls-remote before cloning)
upstream.fetch_method: Exactly one fetch: a single 'git clone https://github.com/listeningpost/vibeline' into a scratch directory outside the workspace, then 'git checkout d5d0f425a64906ae1a50c1222314a5420da404d5' (which is refs/heads/main HEAD). Files were copied byte-for-byte from that checked-out worktree; no other revision was fetched or substituted, and the vendored files were re-verified byte-identical against 'git cat-file blob' output at the pin.

execution_policy: Inert reference material only. Nothing upstream is executed by Orbit at runtime: Orbit does not import, execute, install or otherwise run any vendored upstream file. The vendored subset carries no startup or install hook (the upstream direct-execution entrypoints __main__.py and cli.py and the install.sh/plugin.yaml/Makefile packaging surfaces were deliberately left out of the vendored subset), and no Orbit runtime code references this directory. The acceptance gate tests/test_rails_vendor.py inspects the vendored bytes statically and proves it never imports any vendored module.

integrity.digest_algorithm: SHA-256, computed over exact file bytes
integrity.upstream_blob_crosscheck: Each vendored file's SHA-256 was additionally cross-checked against the SHA-256 of the corresponding git blob object at the pin, so a copy drift between worktree and object database would have been caught.
house_scan_exceptions: Pristine upstream bytes contain lines that match the house secret-scan patterns. Per the frozen spec these files are left byte-identical (unmodified); the coordinator owns any gate exception.
